title: Mangga Tetangga
mood: santuy, a whole afternoon spent waiting for one mango
subject: waiting all afternoon under the neighbour's overhanging mango tree because, by kampung custom, fruit that falls on your side is yours
caption: Indonesian roots reggae. One-drop drums with the kick and cross-stick landing together on beat three and dub delay throws on the snare, an offbeat electric guitar skank with tight muted chops, a Hammond organ bubble shuffling between the skanks, a deep, round melodic bass riff carrying the hook, short horn-section riffs answering the chorus, and a spring-reverb and tape-echo dub drop in the breakdown. Warm and roomy, the bass loud and round in the middle of the mix, the voice relaxed and slightly behind the beat. Relaxed male baritone singing laid-back melodies, with a singjay toasting passage in the second verse. 76 BPM, G major. Santuy: a whole afternoon spent waiting for one mango, and nobody in a hurry. No trap drums, no EDM, no autotune, no dangdut or dansa party beat, no rock guitar solo.
lyrics:
[Intro - one-drop drums, bass riff, organ bubble]

[Verse 1]
Pohon mangga tetangga condong ke halamanku
Buahnya satu, gede, kuning, tinggal nunggu jatuh
Kata orang tua, yang jatuh di sini punyaku
Jadi aku duduk di bawahnya dari jam dua

[Chorus - horns answer]
Santuy, santuy, tunggu aja
Mangganya nggak bakal ke mana-mana
Angin juga nanti lewat sendiri
Aku di sini, kursi plastik, kopi item

[Verse 2 - singjay toasting]
Bu Yati di balik pagar ikut bawa kursi
Katanya batangnya di tanahnya, jadi itu punya dia
Aku bilang daunnya nyampah di halamanku tiap pagi
Anak-anak gang taruhan, ayam-ayam ikut nonton
Matahari turun, mangganya tetap diam

[Chorus - horns answer]
Santuy, santuy, tunggu aja
Mangganya nggak bakal ke mana-mana
Angin juga nanti lewat sendiri
Bu Yati bawa sambal, aku bawa pisau

[Bridge - dub break, echoes on the snare]
Selow, selow
Bluk!

[Outro - horn riff, then bass alone]
Jatuhnya pas di atas pagar
Ya udah, kita bikin rujak berdua
